correctness.rationale: For q=3 the 18-edge overlap digraph has two components, each a 9-cycle. For q>=4 the balanced graph is strongly connected because its degree-one contraction is the parity lift of the primitive non-backtracking digraph of K_q. The exact Ihara spectrum gives a single zero Laplacian eigenvalue and nonzero eigenvalue product 2d(d²-1)^(q(q-3)+1)(q d³)^(q-1), d=q-2. Matrix-tree / 2q(q-1) gives the rooted arborescence count, degree-one subdivision does not change it, and BEST with a fixed initial arc gives rotation classes without extra division. Full and reduced exact cofactors match q=3,4,5; direct cyclic windows of constructed Euler tours match q=4,5,6,7. Finite experiments do not substitute for the proof.

originality.rationale: The restricted target family is not the unrestricted one-or-two-copy family treated by Gardner--Godbole: its three-letter-alphabet subgraph has two components while the full augmented-onto family is Eulerian. Chen--Kitaev--Sun analyzes deleting one or two words, not this large locally defined subfamily. Glover--Kempton supplies a general non-backtracking spectral identity, but not the exact count of Euler tours of this particular parity-lift overlap graph. Published-record and precise formula searches did not reveal an equivalent or dominating count; unindexed derivations remain a residual risk.
residual_risks: An unindexed exact Euler-tour enumeration for the bipartite lift of complete-graph non-backtracking walks could imply the same count.

value.rationale: The adjacent-repeat restriction is motivated by universal cycles with prescribed symbol multiplicities and turns a known cyclable length-four three-symbol language into a disconnected sublanguage. It yields a sharp q=4 threshold, an explicit infinite-family factorial-power enumeration, and a structural parity-lift/nobacktracking explanation rather than an arbitrary finite table. It resolves a natural exact invariant of restricted de Bruijn systems; no broader downstream theorem is claimed.
